title: Funding-aware OOS integration
changes: Backtester accepts an explicit FundingSchedule and wires it to the canonical TradeSimulator fill/close path.
FundingSchedule now carries an evidence coverage window and exposes a fail-closed covers() gate.
Frozen OOS execution accepts an explicit funding schedule and rejects an OOS interval outside verified funding coverage.
Added verified funding-artifact loader that validates exact market-data bytes, REAL provenance, evidence window coverage, and schedule coverage before OOS execution.
Frozen OOS output now exposes gross_pnl, commission, slippage, funding, and net_pnl attribution without treating missing funding as zero when funding evidence is required.
reason_blocked: No genuine venue funding capture was available in the environment; public Delta access previously failed with DNS resolution failure. Therefore no OOS profitability/economics result is certified from this phase.
next_unblocked_work: Use genuine Delta funding-history evidence bound to the exact historical market-data bytes.
Run deterministic funding-aware OOS replay on an eligible genuine dataset when evidence coverage exists.
Produce before/after economics attribution at trade and aggregate levels.
Continue venue fee/spread/slippage certification and live/paper economics remediation.
